name: Fear-extreme + bb_z washout on 4h bars (intraday capitulation snap, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: the capitulation-confluence thesis (forced retail seller vs patient accumulator) taken to the 4h timeframe to catch the FASTER intraday flush-and-snap. On 4h, an extreme-fear reading coinciding with a deep bb_z washout marks a same-session panic where the discount reverts within hours rather than days; fractional holds let us harvest the quick snapback and get out before a second leg. Distinct from the 1d capitulation spec by clock: it tests whether the sentiment discount reverts intraday and whether the edge survives the higher 4h fee cadence. Long; exit on fear relief or time. DISCONFIRMER: 4h round-trips pay fees far more often — if per-trade net edge < 2x fee+slippage the faster clock is worse; kill and prefer 1d. If the confluence subset does not beat fear-alone on 4h, the TA gate adds nothing (buy-the-dip beta) — kill.
catalyst: extreme fear into a 4h bb_z washout (intraday flush)
